subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: Should `AgentOptions.prepareNextTurnWithContext` become the permanent public plugin SDK contract for applying session state changes between loop turns?
rationale: The patch adds a parallel public hook and regenerated SDK baseline; tests can verify behavior, but only maintainers can choose the long-term API boundary and compatibility commitment.

options.title: Approve the additive hook
options.body: Keep the context-aware hook as the public contract, document precedence over the existing hook, and retain focused compatibility tests for both paths.

options.title: Keep the adapter internal
options.body: Move context-aware refresh into the session/runtime integration and avoid expanding the public plugin API.

options.title: Evolve the existing hook
options.body: Design a deprecation or signature-migration plan for `prepareNextTurn` instead of maintaining two parallel permanent hooks.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive hook
recommendation.body: Keep the context-aware hook as the public contract, document precedence over the existing hook, and retain focused compatibility tests for both paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged agent-runtime history and current work span both the session wrapper and public agent API affected by this choice.
